entities.name: Symbiotes
entities.description: Alien ooze-like parasitic life forms that bond with a host body, granting abilities while influencing the mind.

entities.name: Knull
entities.description: Primordial deity who created the symbiotes from the Living Abyss and used them to conquer planets.

entities.name: Living Abyss
entities.description: Source from which the symbiotes were created at the beginning of the universe.

entities.name: Klyntar
entities.description: Artificial planet in the Andromeda Galaxy where Knull was imprisoned; also the symbiotes' name for themselves.

entities.name: Through the Omenpaths
entities.description: Story in which Magic's symbiotes make their in-universe debut.

events.summary: Knull creates the symbiotes from the Living Abyss and uses them to devour civilizations.
events.quote: Symbiotes were created from the Living Abyss at the beginning of the universe by the primordial deity Knull

events.summary: Knull's connection to the symbiotes is severed in battle and they seek new hosts.
events.quote: Eventually, his connection to the symbiotes was severed during a battle

events.summary: Symbiotes rebel against Knull and imprison him on an artificial planet.
events.quote: some of the symbiotes rebelling against Knull and imprisoning him on an artificial planet in the Andromeda Galaxy

relations.note: Created them from the Living Abyss.
relations.quote: Symbiotes were created from the Living Abyss at the beginning of the universe by the primordial deity Knull
